Arrival checks, an update after departure
We write to travelers
Arrival checks for companion animals

Travelers should know that arrival checks help confirm each animal is settled, visible, and ready for the next stage of the trip. Please keep travel papers close at hand, follow crew guidance, and stay nearby until the passenger coordinator has finished the review. This helps the desk protect animal welfare and keep the process calm for everyone involved.

At Aurelia Skyways, trained staff give each animal patient attention and look for signs that extra care may be needed. If a carrier has shifted, if bedding needs adjustment, or if a pet seems uneasy, tell the desk right away. Clear updates from travelers make it easier to support a safe handoff and dependable companion travel.

For help with arrival checks or any post-departure update, please contact the Companion Animal Travel Desk.
